note: The public Google Calendar the What's On page embeds. Leave calendarId empty until a dedicated community calendar exists: the page then shows the regular meetings and the 'add an event' panel instead of an embed. Never put a personal address here - the whole history of an embedded calendar is publicly downloadable. A calendar made for this purpose has an id ending in @group.calendar.google.com; the build refuses a consumer mail address. publicUrl is optional and only used for the 'open in Google Calendar' link.

partners.title: Mallacoota District Health and Support Service
partners.why: MDHSS's own external calendar. The address is a gmail one, but it is an account made to hold this calendar rather than a person's mailbox, and MDHSS already embed it publicly on their own site, which is what publishedAt records.
